scope: Organic support contact tip classification and branch continuity

verification.summary: Reviewed contact tip initialization: local collision clearance is not proof of a flat landing. Removed CONTACT_TO_MODEL from the gracious flag while retaining normal branch collision clipping, local tip footprint rules, and the previous roof stack correction. The rebuilt affected native suite passed84cases18107assertions, including a prior-algorithm failing sloped-landing fixture and checks of actual consecutive-layer branch material. Original Benchy re-slice exit0:30failed candidates became0warnings, identical configuration and model extrusion geometry, preserved four-plane roof stack. Full findings are in docs/evidence/benchy-organic-branch-continuation-20261016.md. Source hashes bind reviewed worktree bytes; the commit is only a checkout anchor.
verification.method: Counterexample diagnostics, native red-to-green regression and original-project re-slice

conclusion: A locally collision-safe CONTACT_TO_MODEL candidate does not establish a flat model landing. Only avoidance-classified gracious candidates and build-plate candidates set to_model_gracious during organic tip initialization. Otherwise ordinary collision-based model-resting propagation must remain available for inclined surfaces; forcing flat-landing avoidance can delete valid tips and emit failed influence-area expansion warnings. Preserve normal branch clearances and the separate local contact-footprint exception.
